title: Web UI Docker and installer integration

context.summary: Make the Web UI a first-class Docker Compose and installer runtime service.
context.background: TASK-126 through TASK-129 implemented the UI package and feature workspaces. The remaining integration scope is packaging the UI into the Docker/release/installer path so local quickstart and persistent-local deployments expose it by default.

in: Add a real docker-compose ui service using apps/ui/dist/server.js.
Build @mindory/ui static assets in the release Docker image.
Expose MINDORY_UI_HOST, MINDORY_UI_PORT and MINDORY_UI_API_URL through Compose and installer-generated env.
Add installer wizard/config/runtime support for UI port and include ui in runtime startup and health waits.
Make pnpm mvp:up report the Web UI URL and wait for the ui service.
Update docs, config examples and validators for Docker/installer Web UI support.
out: Playwright E2E acceptance, which is TASK-131.
Changing Web UI product features already implemented in TASK-126 through TASK-129.
Adding reverse-proxy or TLS automation beyond the existing public URL setting.

acceptance_criteria: Docker Compose defines a ui service that runs the built @mindory/ui server, publishes MINDORY_UI_PORT and health-checks /health.
The release Docker image builds UI static assets before runtime startup.
Installer-generated env and wizard support MINDORY_UI_PORT, route UI /api traffic to the API service and include ui in startup readiness.
pnpm mvp:up waits for the ui service and prints the local Web UI URL.
README, deployment, installer, UI, configuration, architecture, support matrix, repository status and changelog describe the supported UI Docker/installer path.
pnpm check includes Web UI Docker/installer validation.

manual_checks: Confirm docker-compose.yml contains a ui service with command node apps/ui/dist/server.js and /health healthcheck.
Confirm installer first-run credentials include ui_url for local quickstart users.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
